**Wrap the MDM check error with operation context.** When the configuration lookup fails, the returned error has no message identifying the staged-upload MDM check. Wrap it to add that context to the error chain.
Suggested fix

```diff --- "a/ee/server/service/staged_upload.go" +++ "b/ee/server/service/staged_upload.go" @@ -31,7 +31,7 @@ if target == fleet.StagedUploadTargetBootstrapPackage { if err := svc.VerifyMDMAppleConfigured(ctx); err != nil { - return nil, err + return nil, ctxerr.Wrap(ctx, err, "check Apple MDM configuration for staged upload") } } ```
As per coding guidelines, “When a `context.Context` is available (most server code), wrap errors with `ctxerr.Wrap(ctx, err, "description")`.”
Committable suggestion

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion return nil, ctxerr.Wrap(ctx, err, "check Apple MDM configuration for staged upload") ```

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title "fix: require Apple MDM for bootstrap staged uploads" matches the main change. The change makes CreateStagedUpload verify that Apple MDM is configured before it issues an upload URL for a bootstrap package. Software package uploads keep their existing flow. The title is short, specific, and uses a conventional commit prefix.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the template structure. It links the issue (Resolves `#58104`), explains the change and why it is needed, and keeps software package uploads independent of Apple MDM. It completes the checklist items that apply, including the changes file, validation, and automated tests. The AI section is present in the required format with the tool name Codex and the model listed as unknown. The author marked the manual GCS QA item as not done, and the 'Changes file' checkbox is checked while the summary lists only a changelog entry. The description is mostly complete and clear, so it passes.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Objective [`#58104`]: with Apple MDM off, a `bootstrap_package` staged upload request must fail before an upload URL is issued. The head adds a check in `CreateStagedUpload` (ee/server/service/staged_upload.go). The check runs only when `target == fleet.StagedUploadTargetBootstrapPackage`, after the authorization switch and before the `stagedUploadStore` nil check and before presigning. It calls `svc.VerifyMDMAppleConfigured(ctx)` and returns its error. In server/service/mdm.go, `VerifyMDMAppleConfigured` returns `fleet.ErrMDMNotConfigured` when `appCfg.MDM.EnabledAndConfigured` is false, and it propagates datastore `AppConfig` errors. This covers the 'MDM configuration lookup error' case in the PR tests. The raw summary reports table-driven tests for enabled, disabled, and lookup-error bootstrap cases, and for software uploads with MDM disabled. I did not read the test file, so test behavior rests on the summary. I did not confirm that the bootstrap registration endpoint returns the identical error text. The sentinel is the MDM-configuration error the PR uses, and the issue describes it as the same error. Objective [`#58104`]: software package uploads are unchanged. The new check is gated on the bootstrap target, so software uploads do not depend on Apple MDM.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR diff (merge base b8b9148 to head 5c3f64b) includes three kinds of change. (1) `ee/server/service/staged_upload.go`: a six-line gated MDM check for the bootstrap target. This implements the linked issue directly. (2) `ee/server/service/staged_upload_test.go`: a `PresignPut` test double, table-driven tests for MDM outcomes, and import updates. These support the new behavior. (3) `changes/58104-bootstrap-staged-upload-mdm`: a changelog entry for the user-visible change. Software-package behavior is not altered, since the check only runs for the bootstrap target. No unrelated changes were found in the reviewed summary or in the one diff I read.
